name: AI Trend Studio
tagline: AI video generator with trending effects like AI Kiss and AI Hug.
description: AI Trend Studio is a chat-directed AI studio for making trending short videos and images. Upload a photo or type a prompt and turn it into image-to-video or text-to-video clips with popular effects such as AI Kiss, AI Hug, AI Muscle, AI Dance, Flash Fashion, AI Baby, Action Figure and Ghibli Style. Video runs on MiniMax H3, Seedance, Kling V4, Gemini Omni, and Muse; stills use GPT Image and Nano Banana. On the pricing page checked 2026-11-10, Starter is $19.90/month or $16.66/month billed yearly ($199.90/year, 2,400 credits a year), Pro is $39.90/month or $33.33/month billed yearly ($399.90/year, 5,400 credits a year), and Studio is $79.90/month or $66.66/month billed yearly ($799.90/year, 12,000 credits a year).
